reviews.text: Kaia was our server last night and she was excellent. I hope I get seated in her section. The next time I come.
Had a great time with the group and local took care of us!
Derks was awesome. All of her recommendations were great

Our table had an amazing experience tonight, and a big part of that was our incredible server, Karina. She was warm, attentive, friendly, and made sure everything was perfect throughout our meal.

Our group of friends gets together once a month, and this time we decided to try somewhere different from our usual neighborhood spot. We're so glad we did! The food was great, but Karina's outstanding service truly made the evening special.

By the time we left, everyone at the table was talking about how wonderful she was. She made us feel welcome, took great care of us, and helped make our night one to remember. We will definitely be back and hope to see Karina again. Thank you for such a fantastic dining experience!
❤️CLUB - A happy group of 7-20 usually !
Ewan provided great service on the upper patio. Kind and caring with our kids
Ewan is great on the upper patio.
We were served by an awesome waiter named Daniel!  Well done for your first few shifts.  Your rocked dude!
I always get the tuna bowl to go and it's fresh every single time. Really nice staff too:) I appreciate the treat !!!

Went to watch Argentina vs England game with a friend. The staff was amazing and always available despite both floors being packed due to the game. The food was amazing, my rare stake was out of this world, I ordered rare. $40 was totally justified. Accidentally spilled my beer in the heat of the game, asked for another pint even though the one I spilled was almost done. Was only charged for one. Will be back most definitely.
Daniel was such a great server & took great care of my sister and I during a busy rush! Will definitely be coming back!

Great food! Exceptional service!! I have been to many, many restaurants and I can honestly say that the service provided by Paige and the team was absolutely amazing!!! The food and drinks were delicious. The only “hiccup” we had was a mix up in the kitchen and they made a mistake on one of our meals. Paige immediately addressed it and took full responsibility for the mistake (even thought I don’t think it was actually her fault). Between Paige and the managers they not only “made it right” they actually went above and beyond to make sure that we had a super positive experience. I look forward to enjoying many more meals here and hoping that Paige will be our server again. ❤️
The food and our server Daniel were great
Daniel did a great job.
Daniel was great!

I've been several times, and have always enjoyed the experience. I honestly cannot think of a time I didn't enjoy it.

As for staff, great. Typically very friendly and fun. (I say typically because everyone has off days, so no grudges on once or twice with shortness from service)

To note; Carolina was very personable as far as a bar tender, with solid recommendations. I actually promised to write this review a year ago because I loved her service, forgot, had her again and immediately remembered. (She did not ask for the record out of brazen humility)

Definitely worth checking out in Leaside.
Thanks to Paulveen for her awesome service!

Had such a fantastic time visiting this spot recently. The atmosphere is wonderful, especially when sitting outside under the umbrellas on a nice day. It is the perfect place to relax with friends.

Everything we ordered was delicious. We especially enjoyed the espresso martini, which came topped with those three perfect coffee beans. We will definitely be back again soon.
Maria was such an attentive server made sure we were well taken care of the entire night (plus the SA Deanna), highly recommend!!!!!
Maria was an amazing server!! Had a great experience.
maría was amazing!!!

Local Leaside is our go to, especially when my elderly parents are in town, and the location and staff are so accommodating to people with mobility issues. It is one of only a handful of places in the east end that has a bathroom on the ground floor (vs the basement). And, as always, the food is amazing and the staff are so nice!
Came here for some drinks and food and the service was amazing. Kayla was awesome!!
We really enjoy going to the Local the food is fantastic and the service is great!

Harrison was amazing , attentive to everyone that he engaged from Yonge told
Great job!!!  Top service.  Thank you 🙏
Derks was very nice and friendly! Great experience
Baby friendly - great food and service! The staff was very kind and accommodating since we went with our 1 year old son. The food was good and the ambience was nice!
My mom and I went for lunch and it was a great time! The food was really tasty and Meklit was so accommodating and sweet to us!
maria was absolutely incredible, she was so accommodating and kind - she made our experience amazing
Maria is an amazing server 10/10, will come back because of her!!!
Maria is the best! Absolutely classy and amazing to me and my friends.
Maria took care of our large group and remembered all of our names and orders so well.
Maria was an amazing waitress! She took care of our large group
thanks maria !
Maria was awesome!
Aijia was so welcoming! Thank you for such great service!

We decided to come for dinner for the first time in quite a while, and had such a great time. We had Daniel as our server and couldn't have had a better experience. He helped us out with the menu making great recommendations and making sure we had everything we needed throughout our night. If you decide to come to local, make sure you're asking for Daniel!

I enjoy the vibe at this place. The food is very good. I especially like the tuna poke bowl.  Service is always friendly with a smile and you leave the place with a smile on your face. A very good experience.
Food was excellent. Recommend asking for the ceaser salad cut instead of a wedge. Burgers are delicious. Nicola is an amazing server.
Norah and Kaitlyn were fantastic and were very impressed with their service.
Norah and Kaitlyn were wonderful!!!!!!
Daniel our server made our night! Super quick and attentive service, seems like a total pro.
Daniel the man
Food was good but found it little overpriced for what I had. I had fish and chips, the fish was a little on the small side good thing I had ordered a second piece with the meal.
Harrison is by far the best waiter I’ve ever had
Had a great time here! Food was great and portioned well. Prices are good! But it was our waiter Harrison who ELEVATED our experience. He was very kind and accommodating! best waiter I’ve ever had.
Food was great. Harrison was a wonderful waiter. He was very informed on the menu, and provided such great service. So fun to talk to!
The food was great! Harrison was so welcoming, made great conversation and provided amazing service. Would definitely come again!

Celebrated my birthday here and reserved the patio for my party of ~40ppl. We had such a great time! Special thanks to Ben, Vico, and Sophie for taking care of us and accommodating all of our requests. The food and drinks were delicious (especially the steak and margaritas) and all came with good timing. My group was able to have separate bills and the team did a great job at keeping everything organized. Lovely team to communicate and plan with beforehand (shoutout Nicky!), the night couldn't have gone any better!!

Had an amazing experience at Local Public Eatery!! I was served by Meklit who was very nice and went through the menu with us , since it was my and I’s first time there. After dinner Qam came by and gave us a desert on the house which was absolutely delicious.  Strongly recommend this place. Great food and good vibes!!!

Had the most amazing time at Local today, was in for the soccer game on a very busy patio and our server was Sydney. She handle the rush with ease and made sure our drinks were always full and she was very knowledgeable about the whole menu when we were deciding what to eat. Food and drinks were 10/10 as always. One of the best restaurant experiences I’ve ever had. Will definitely be back and will be requesting Sydney in the future!
Great low key place with exceptional service
Daniel are server was brilliant. Top guy and food and drinks great.
We had a great experience. Daniel was our server and he was incredibly attentive, friendly and accommodating of us with our toddler at the table. Highly recommend asking for him !
You will love it

Me and my bestie came to local to watch a fifa match, got placed upstairs on the rooftop bar, and the seats were perfect, right in front of the tv, food was great, our bartenders were so incredibly sweet, so shout out to Kaitlyn and Derka for making the experience so much better, very attentive, checking in on us every so often, overall we had such a great time and will be back!  🥹

My roommate and I came to Local Leaside to watch the FIFA World Cup and had the BEST time. We were up on the rooftop and the whole vibe was unreal. Huge shoutout to Kaitlyn S and Derka, their energy made the experience even better. They were so welcoming, fun, and really brought the atmosphere to life. Between the game, the crowd, and the service, everything was on point. Definitely one of those nights you don’t forget. Can’t wait to come back!
Staff were great, however I found the prices were at little high for what you got but that won't stop me from going again
First time at Local and it was great! Big shout out to Sydney for amazing service. She was attentive, asked us how our food was and refilled our drinks. Will definitely come back
Our server Danielle was exceptional. She made the dining experience incredible! The food and service was amazing, I highly recommend bringing everyone you know here
The food and service was incredible. We watched the England game here and the atmosphere was amazing. Danielle was so friendly and a great server.
Eliza was the nicest waitress I’ve ever had. Amazing.

Always amazing service and especially Paige and Hazmile working on Canada in 40 plus degrees! Kudos to the chefs also! All together 5 star experience always!
Happy Canada Day The Local Staff!!!
